long_definition: More than 512 BERT content tokens, excluding special tokens
source: Assistant-authored synthetic clear requests. 50 short requests retained by category/order, without consulting errors; 50 long variants based on ten new reports.
independence: 50 short requests were already evaluated. Five long requests share each report. Labels are assistant-authored and wording templates are shared; not independently human-annotated real-user data.
selection: The first half of each saved category was retained, irrespective of correctness. Long reports and expected labels fixed before frozen-model inference. No model tuning or prediction-error filtering.
